assignment_submission_windows_closing.name: assignment_submission_windows_closing
assignment_submission_windows_closing.value: ("assignment_submission_windows"."state" = 'open' OR "assignment_submission_windows"."closes_at" IS NULL) AND ("assignment_submission_windows"."closes_at" IS NULL OR (length("assignment_submission_windows"."closes_at") = 24 AND substr("assignment_submission_windows"."closes_at", 24, 1) = 'Z' AND julianday("assignment_submission_windows"."closes_at") IS NOT NULL))

curriculum_versions_approval_pair.name: curriculum_versions_approval_pair
curriculum_versions_approval_pair.value: ("curriculum_reference_versions"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "curriculum_reference_versions"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("curriculum_reference_versions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "curriculum_reference_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

identity_admin_events_flags.name: identity_admin_events_flags
identity_admin_events_flags.value: ("identity_admin_events"."previous_enabled" IS NULL OR "identity_admin_events"."previous_enabled" IN (0, 1)) AND "identity_admin_events"."next_enabled" IN (0, 1)

profile_link_events_target.name: profile_link_events_target
profile_link_events_target.value: ("profile_link_events"."profile_type" = 'student' AND "profile_link_events"."student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_link_events"."student_id" = "profile_link_events"."profile_id" AND "profile_link_events"."guardian_id" IS NULL) OR ("profile_link_events"."profile_type" = 'guardian' AND "profile_link_events"."guardian_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_link_events"."guardian_id" = "profile_link_events"."profile_id" AND "profile_link_events"."student_id" IS NULL)

profile_link_versions_target.name: profile_link_versions_target
profile_link_versions_target.value: ("profile_link_versions"."profile_type" = 'student' AND "profile_link_versions"."student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_link_versions"."student_id" = "profile_link_versions"."profile_id" AND "profile_link_versions"."guardian_id" IS NULL) OR ("profile_link_versions"."profile_type" = 'guardian' AND "profile_link_versions"."guardian_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_link_versions"."guardian_id" = "profile_link_versions"."profile_id" AND "profile_link_versions"."student_id" IS NULL)

reading_checks_word_counts.name: reading_checks_word_counts
reading_checks_word_counts.value: typeof("reading_checks"."words_attempted") = 'integer' AND typeof("reading_checks"."words_correct") = 'integer' AND "reading_checks"."words_attempted" BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "reading_checks"."words_correct" BETWEEN 0 AND "reading_checks"."words_attempted"

reading_corrections_word_counts.name: reading_corrections_word_counts
reading_corrections_word_counts.value: typeof("reading_corrections"."words_attempted") = 'integer' AND typeof("reading_corrections"."words_correct") = 'integer' AND "reading_corrections"."words_attempted" BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "reading_corrections"."words_correct" BETWEEN 0 AND "reading_corrections"."words_attempted"

resource_versions_approval_pair.name: resource_versions_approval_pair
resource_versions_approval_pair.value: ("resource_versions"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "resource_versions"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("resource_versions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
